articles.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
articles.snippet: The U.K. claims to aspire to become a global cryptocurrency hub, an ambition that would appear to be at odds with the attitude to crypto purchases of its major banks.

articles.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has sunk to its weakest level in more than one month.

articles.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan
articles.snippet: Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22.

articles.title: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports
articles.snippet: The company's head of futures and prediction markets said bitcoin, gold and oil contracts are among its fastest-growing prediction markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
articles.snippet: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for flaws a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.
